qualified_contracts: CS-base/limit and paged original-byte authentication, first mismatch exits, EIP and RF completion.
Original INT1/ICEBP, INT3 and INTO with debugger interception disabled; ICEBP completes and clears RF before its faultable #DB entry.
Selector-transition integration with persistent MOV/POP SS and STI windows; LSS does not inhibit.
16/32-bit interrupt and trap gates, all CPLs, conforming targets, GDT/LDT and 16/32-bit TSS stacks.
Independent gate, code, stack and TSS widths; offset-first TSS reads, actual extent, and SS.D/B-owned ESP high bits.
Fault/software/IRQ/NMI frame classification, saved RF, error codes, CR2, NMI blocking and host-backing distinction.
Ordered descriptor/frame effects and transactional register/cache publication, with recursive #DF/shutdown.
Independent native vector recorders and same-ring fault entries distinguish #TS/#SS/#NP from a merely matching shutdown or error-code frame.
Target EIP-limit checks follow the full frame, including an error code; competing stack #PF and preceding writes take priority.
Recursive #DF preserves the failed fault entry RF image under the bound legacy processor profile.
Shared event kinds, error-code sets, descriptor rules, virtual-interrupt conflict and nested-fault pairing with IA-32e.
native_exclusions: KVM debugger RF in the final live flags of breakpoint-stopped cases; saved frame RF and debugger-free trap-case live RF are compared.
Undefined register/cache values on shutdown; retained ordinary RAM and CR2 are compared.
Legacy #DF program-state results are processor-profile choices, not universal architectural guarantees; IA-32e keeps its separate undefined-frame exclusions.
Test recorders write a vector cell outside the compared architectural frames using register-preserving MOV/JMP.
No physical task/call-gate, IRET, VM86, CET/FRED, SMM, SGX or external-device qualification is claimed.

diagnostics.finding: Disproved selector-first TSS reads: native CR2 identifies the offset field.
Exposed retained ESP high bits with a 16-bit target stack.
Disproved TSS width as the owner of that high-word choice; the target SS.D/B decides it.
Disproved target EIP-limit validation before frame writes: the same-ring rescue entry exposes the failed inner frame.
Real initial #GP exposed the prior fault entry RF image retained in the recursive #DF frame.
Original ICEBP with KVM guest debugging disabled disproved retaining pre-instruction RF in its #DB frame in both code widths and paging modes.
The merged CLI used incompatible optional integer types at its C ABI boundary on LP64 Linux; repaired with an explicit uint64_t optional.

A separate hardware-only audit observed full-CS-limit instruction fetch wrapping at 4 GiB on both cores in nonpaged protected mode. It is consistent with the byte-fetch implementation by inspection; no model comparison or additional qualification count is claimed.
